posts.name: Ronaldo
posts.cooked:
Is the damage given to each hero dealing damage or just to the first hero dealing damage?

The question is, how is turn defined? Is it the global turn, counting from villain’s turn to villain’s turn? Or, is each hero’s turn considered a separate turn?

Thanks
posts.raw:
Is the damage given to each hero dealing damage or just to the first hero dealing damage?

The question is, how is turn defined? Is it the global turn, counting from villain's turn to villain's turn? Or, is each hero's turn considered a separate turn?

Thanks

posts.name: awp832
posts.cooked:
each hero’s turn is a turn. the environment turn is a turn, and the villan turn is a turn.

cards meant to have “round” lasting effects are worded as such; eg Legacy’s Galvanize reads “Until the start of your next turn…”
posts.raw:
each hero's turn is a turn.  the environment turn is a turn, and the villan turn is a turn.

cards meant to have "round"  lasting effects are worded as such; eg Legacy's [i]Galvanize[/i]  reads "Until the start of your next turn.."

posts.name: BerkMarc
posts.cooked:
What happens when Backlash Field is activated as a result of Atlantean Font of Power? (Each hero has to play the top card of their hero deck, but it remains the environment deck’s turn.) Would only the first hero to do damage in this way receive the backlash, or each of them? My inclination is to give each hero the damage as normal, but perhaps it needs it needs a whole turn to “recharge”.

I really hate Backlash Field by the way

posts.name: TheJayMann
posts.cooked: In that case, the heroes are not taking turns, they are simply playing the top card of their deck as part of the environment turn, so only the first target to deal damage to Baron Blade during the environment turn gets targetted by Backlash field.
posts.raw: In that case, the heroes are not taking turns, they are simply playing the top card of their deck as part of the environment turn, so only the first target to deal damage to Baron Blade during the environment turn gets targetted by Backlash field.
